task.pr_title: feat(cli): co-locate bundle with CLI binary for packager-managed installs

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: Is the limited exception handling intentional or would it make sense to do a simple catch all here? Otherwise there are failures that could bubble up instead of falling back to the null handler.

evidence.thread_resolution:
radical: It was intentional so we are catching only the relevant ones and not ignoring bugs. But catch all would be safer.
radical: Fixed in `1652ea9fb0`. Broadened to `catch (Exception)` with a debug log so any failure path (`IOException`, `JsonException`, permission errors, anything else) falls through cleanly to the parent-of-binary heuristic instead of bubbling up. The log line includes the sidecar path and inner exception so the failure stays diagnosable.
